author: Zandres2
quote:
This game is absolutely beautiful, and while it is the grand adventure we remember from the original release in 1998, it's beautifully retold in ultra HD.

The dedicated jump button takes a bit to get used to because of muscle memory of the auto jump, but you very quickly adapt.

I had soooo much fun with this one, and with voice acting, re-orchestrated music and effects, it's like a whole new game while being a beautiful retelling of a fabled adventure from the N64.
